purpose: Convert the existing blind second-pass judge reliability evidence into an executable claim boundary for model-judged grounded-correctness metrics.

stable_enough_for_current_reporting.evidence: 7/8 exact agreement on unsupported-answer hard rows.
4/4 exact agreement on correct-abstention sanity checks.
21/24 exact agreement on cross-policy disagreement rows.

not_stable_enough_for_current_reporting.evidence: 0/6 exact agreement on questionable-abstention rows; 6 P0 rows require adjudication.
All completed correctness metrics are model-judged; no human adjudication file is present.

required_before_submission_claim: Adjudicate all P0 abstention-boundary rows with a human or stronger independent judge before claiming abstention calibration is solved.
Spot-adjudicate P1 support-boundary rows before treating unsupported/support rates as human truth.
Report judge prompts, schemas, model, exact-agreement rate, disagreement taxonomy, and examples in the paper.
Label Qwen 3B support metrics as model-judged unless a human/stronger-judge adjudication file closes this gate.
manuscript_constraints: Use 'model-judged grounded correctness' for current metrics.
Do not use 'human-validated' or 'gold correctness' for model-judge outputs.
Report answer support, abstention support, answer rate, and judge disagreement together.
Describe abstention-boundary calibration as unresolved unless the P0 queue is adjudicated.

llm_budget.note: This gate reuses existing second-pass and taxonomy artifacts and makes no new calls.
